rules.title: Boston Fair Chance Tenant Selection Policy – criminal history screening limits
rules.requirement: Covered housing providers may not use blanket bans on applicants with arrests or convictions and must evaluate applicants case by case. They may not consider non-conviction arrests, sealed or expunged convictions, juvenile records, or convictions more than 5 years old when deciding eligibility or eviction.
rules.key_value: Convictions older than 5 years may not be considered
rules.coverage_conditions: Housing providers receiving Boston Department of Neighborhood Development (DND) funding and/or land, or with income-restricted units created under the BPDA Inclusionary Development Policy; also applied to the Office of Fair Housing and Equity Affirmative Marketing Program.
rules.exemptions: Does not apply where there is a direct relationship between a conviction and the housing sought or an unreasonable risk of substantial harm to others, or to current criminal behavior; federal or state criminal history requirements preempt conflicting provisions.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: RESTRICTED: applies only to DND-funded or DND-land housing providers and BPDA Inclusionary Development Policy income-restricted units (and the OFHE Affirmative Marketing Program).

rules.citation: Boston Department of Neighborhood Development, Boston Fair Chance Tenant Selection Policy (February 2017)
rules.quoted_span: a) Arrests that did not result in conviction. This includes dismissed charges, diversion
rules.conflict_note: This is an agency funding/program policy that providers agree to, not a codified ordinance. The document is dated February 2017 and states no separate effective date.

rules.title: Boston Fair Chance Tenant Selection Policy – credit score and credit history limits
rules.requirement: Covered housing providers may not use an applicant's credit score to approve or deny housing applications. Credit history may be used only in place of rental history when none is available, and a lack of credit history alone is not a sufficient reason to reject an applicant.
rules.key_value: No use of credit score; credit history only in lieu of rental history
rules.coverage_conditions: Housing providers receiving Boston DND funding and/or land, or with income-restricted units under the BPDA Inclusionary Development Policy; also applied to the OFHE Affirmative Marketing Program.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: RESTRICTED: applies only to DND-funded or DND-land housing providers and BPDA Inclusionary Development Policy income-restricted units (and the OFHE Affirmative Marketing Program).
